development.selection: Minimize operational or automatic failures first; then coordinator source-grounded semantic errors and omissions across six existing rubric dimensions; ties retain shared v1. One adaptive revision per provider, maximum 250 added words, no model-specific test answer patches.

validation.freeze: Commit validation cases and protocol before development dispatch. Commit selected prompts before any validation dispatch. No tuning or case/rubric edits after validation outputs are seen.
limitations: Same agent authors validation and prompts; separation prevents tuning on validation outputs but is not independent human holdout.
Related capability families are intentionally shared with development; do not estimate production accuracy from these synthetic cases.

profile: Same provider controls as provider-comparison-v1, Vertex Express, Anthropic prompt-json. Each provider is sequential; up to four providers in parallel. Both validation arms have identical limits and task input; seeded order interleaves arms.
credentials: Use existing local credentials; no keys in artifacts.
pricing: Record estimates using dated public uncached rates. Unknown response usage is not zero; prices are not invoices.
review: Keep automatic and independent AI judgments separate from human labels. Review original and selected answers together anonymously with frozen Notion context and calibration labels hidden.
